resources.string: An offline dictionary for English, standard Croatian and Kajkavian. Search in either language, read full definitions and inflection tables, study example sentences and listen to pronunciations, all without an internet connection.

Definitions, inflection tables, etymologies, related words and Wiktionary example sentences come from the English Wiktionary, written by Wiktionary contributors. They are used under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence, reformatted and abridged for this app; the dictionary data is shared under the same licence.
The Wiktionary data was extracted with wiktextract by Tatu Ylonen and obtained from kaikki.org.
The built-in offline voice is the eSpeak NG speech synthesiser by the eSpeak NG contributors, licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version.
Rječnik links eSpeak NG and is therefore distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 (GPL-3.0). It is provided without any warranty.

Example sentences, commonness ratings and Međimurje Kajkavian equivalents were generated with AI (Claude by Anthropic), then checked by automated tests and a targeted AI correction pass. No human has reviewed them. They may contain mistakes — verify with a native speaker.
Treat Kajkavian forms marked low confidence with particular care.
Rječnik has no internet permission, so it never connects to the internet. Search, definitions, example sentences and pronunciation all work fully offline.
Pronunciation uses an offline Croatian phone voice when one is installed, and the built-in eSpeak NG voice otherwise.
Web addresses are shown as plain text because the app works offline. Long-press one to copy it.
